title: Willard Prescott Smith Professor of Corporate Finance
bio: Joint winner of the Ieke van den Burg Prize for Research on Systemic Risk awarded by the European Systemic Risk Board (ESRB) for “Liquidity Transformation in Asset Management: Evidence from the Cash Holdings of Mutual Funds” (with Sergey Chernenko).

He teaches Finance 2 in the MBA required curriculum and Ph.D. courses in Corporate Finance and Empirical Methods.
